name: mut_hamCoef
doc: the amplitude of the mode `[1, 0]` times `1 + 10⁻³`
check: checkInvariance { cert with ham := hamCoef }

name: mut_torusCoef
doc: the largest Fourier coefficient of `u` times `1 + 10⁻⁴`
check: checkInvariance { cert with emb := ⟨[-1, 0], [⟨⟨0⟩, uHalfMut⟩, ⟨⟨0⟩, []⟩], [0, 0], [p, J]⟩ }

name: mut_witnessCoef
doc: the largest coefficient of the character witness times `1 + 10⁻³`
check: checkInvariance { cert with wit := ⟨[], [], [([1, 0], ⟨⟨E1TermsMut⟩, 0, 30⟩)], []⟩ }

name: mut_err
doc: the residual claim `err` halved
check: checkInvariance { cert with params := { cert.params with err := cert.params.err / 2 } }

name: mut_E0
doc: the energy level `E0` moved by `2 err`
check: checkEnergy { cert with params := { cert.params with E0 := cert.params.E0 + 2 * cert.params.err } }

name: mut_frameL
doc: the frame bound `bL` times `0.99`
check: checkFrameL cert (Rclaim.bL * 99 / 100)

name: mut_frameT
doc: the frame bound `bT` times `0.99`
check: checkFrameT cert (Rclaim.bT * 99 / 100)

name: mut_frameN
doc: the frame bound `bN` times `0.99`
check: checkFrameN cert (Rclaim.bN * 99 / 100) Rclaim.bNt

name: mut_hamClaim
doc: the Hamiltonian claim `dx` times `0.99`
check: checkHamClaim cert { Rclaim with dx := Rclaim.dx * 99 / 100 }

name: mut_nuRay
doc: `nuRay = 10⁻⁵`, above `(s - 1)|ω*| ≈ 10⁻⁶`
check: checkStatic { cert with params := { cert.params with nuRay := 1 / 10 ^ 5 } }

name: mut_dispRoom
doc: `disp = 1`, above the room `(σω - s)|ω*|` of the ray
check: finalOkA (refinedWit.num 2 { cert.params with disp := 1 } cert.freqBox) { cert.params with disp := 1 } cert.freqBox refinedWit.core.Xs

name: mut_theta
doc: route A with `θ = 1`
check: refinedCore 2 cert.params cert.freqBox { refinedWit with core := { refinedWit.core with th := 1 } }

name: mut_Xs
doc: route A with ten times the passing `X⋆`
check: refinedCore 2 cert.params cert.freqBox { refinedWit with core := { refinedWit.core with Xs := refinedWit.core.Xs * 10 } }

name: mut_scheduleB
doc: route B with the schedule ratio `a = 1`
check: refinedBCore 2 cert.params cert.freqBox { refinedBWit with core := { refinedBWit.core with a := 1 } }

name: mut_boxFiber
doc: the frequency box widened to radius `1/20`: the fibers reach the resonance, the sites fail
check: sitesOk (refinedWit.num 2 cert.params boxWide) refinedWit.core.J boxWide refinedWit.κ cert.params.γ refinedWit.sites

name: mut_siteBound
doc: the first site with its bound `B` halved
check: siteOk 2 1 refinedWit.core.J cert.freqBox refinedWit.κ cert.params.γ ((refinedWit.num 2 cert.params cert.freqBox).δ 0) (refinedWit.core.c.getD 0 0) (some ⟨(773227 / 1000000), 6, 8, (4522 / 25)⟩)

name: mut_denominator
doc: a term `10⁻⁹ / (p - p_c)` whose denominator ball contains `0` on the domain
check: checkHamBounds { cert with ham := .add ham (.div (.const (1 / 10 ^ 9)) (.add (.action 0) (.const (63791325795 / 549755813888)))) }

name: mut_sqrtDomain
doc: a term `10⁻⁹ √(p - p_c)` whose operand reaches `Re ≤ 0` on the domain
check: checkHamBounds { cert with ham := .add ham (.mul (.const (1 / 10 ^ 9)) (.sqrt (.add (.action 0) (.const (63791325795 / 549755813888))))) }

name: mut_adviceFull
doc: the first full-stage advice key removed: the crude enclosure of `p²` breaks the energy row
check: checkEnergy { cert with cfgFull := { cert.cfgFull with advice := cert.cfgFull.advice.tail } }

name: mut_adviceLow
doc: the first low-stage advice key removed (crude Gram entry)
check: checkGram { cert with cfgLow := { cert.cfgLow with advice := cert.cfgLow.advice.tail } }

name: mut_angleDeg
doc: `u = 2πU` read at angle degree `0` (as `U`)
check: checkInvariance { cert with emb := ⟨[0, 0], [u, ⟨⟨0⟩, []⟩], [0, 0], [p, J]⟩ }

name: mut_rayScalar
doc: the ray scalar `s = 1 + 10⁻³` against the box of `c / s`
check: checkInvariance { cert with params := { cert.params with s := 1001 / 1000 } }

name: mut_timeScale
doc: the Hamiltonian doubled without rescaling the box
check: checkInvariance { cert with ham := .mul (.const 2) ham }

name: mut_swapActions
doc: the actions `(p, J)` emitted in the order `(J, p)`
check: checkInvariance { cert with emb := ⟨[-1, 0], [u, ⟨⟨0⟩, []⟩], [0, 0], [J, p]⟩ }
